title: The v1beta1 CRDs are still served and need the v1 migration
quote: Karpenter `1.0.0` introduces the `v1` APIs and uses conversion webhooks to support existing `v1beta1` APIs. **Do not** upgrade to `1.0.0`+ without following the `v1` Migration Guide.
remediation: Follow the v1 Migration Guide before upgrading. 1.0 introduces the v1 APIs and keeps v1beta1 working through conversion webhooks — this is the release where both are available, and 1.1 removes v1beta1 entirely, so the migration has to happen here.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("karpenter")) | "\(.metadata.name) served=\([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))"'  # each Karpenter CRD and the API versions it still serves
